definitions.explanation: The tiny orange eggs of the flying fish, used as a sushi topping and as a garnish. The grains are much smaller than salmon roe and pop crisply between the teeth.

examples.japanese: とびこの⟦{軍艦|ぐんかん}→軍艦：14393_gunkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a flying-fish-roe gunkan roll.

examples.japanese: とびこ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プチプチ→プチプチ：06847_puchipuchi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: Flying fish roe has a fun popping texture.

examples.english: Coating the outside of a roll with flying fish roe makes it look far more festive at once.

notes:
Written in kana on most menus; the kanji ⟦{飛|と}び→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ is rare. Often dyed — green with wasabi, black with squid ink — for color on a platter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とびこの⟦{軍艦|ぐんかん}→軍艦：14393_gunkan⟧: gunkan sushi topped with flying fish roe
- とびこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる: to top something with flying fish roe
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とびこ: wasabi-flavored green roe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いくら: salmon roe — large, soft, glossy orange spheres
- ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧: herring roe — a firm block of tiny eggs, eaten at New Year
- ⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧: spicy pollock roe — sold as a whole seasoned sac
